verdict.rationale: Foreloop's own docs describe turning a triaged feedback submission into an intention. Its agent reads the submission, fills in the intention, and proposes the tasks. Intentions carry an agreed purpose and editable deliverables, which serve as the proposed scope. Missing for 10: detail on how the proposed tasks are structured and how their scope is set, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the conversion quality.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can convert user feedback submissions into structured tasks with proposed scope

citations.quote: Turn a real submission into an intention... its agent reads the submission, fills in the intention, and proposes the tasks
